Review 7243048342 requires comparing equivalent loaded program state, not default flat curves vs Cascade Rise. --program sets generator seed 2026 and loads the seed program before capture; layer curves, timing spans, recipe values and the program header therefore show the loaded state.

Reference order: PERFORM, DESIGN, TIMELINE, MOTION, PROCESS, TRIGGER, PRESETS, ADVANCED (native Workspace enum keeps legacy storage order; tab strip follows the reference through a position table and tests assert PERFORM selects tab 0).

(1) persistent playable keyboard + live meter/clock in every native workspace (owner-mandated; reference badge says DSP NOT CONNECTED). (2) Layer dial grid maps REAL native layer parameters only: Gain, Pan, Transpose, Start, Length, Character — no invented Width; per-layer pitch/cutoff are trajectories reached via the 2x2 curve thumbnails (Amp/Pitch/Cutoff/Pan) exactly as the reference. (3) Complexity is a 1-4 layer segmented select (integral native parameter), not a continuous dial. (4) Generator field-lock chips live in the generator card. (5) Selected Program identity is "Seed 2026 · Noise Riser" (native Programs have no authored name field). (6) Compact icon+text tabs with reference selected state replace equal-width gradient tabs.

Mutable theme token trio compiled with hidden visibility (module-private per product binary); FxPanel selects the FX theme before children are constructed; regression test asserts the selected theme and construction-order stability. Drums/Synth appearance untouched: no shared palette value changed; shared-component geometry (knob paint, tab strip, module icons, parameter label size) is the reference design language applied to the shared vox-ui components all three products already use.

VoxKnob paint geometry, VoxTabBar strip style, VoxModule header icons and Typography parameter/tab faces were updated to the pinned reference across products (shared design language). Drums/Synth functional suites pass unchanged; product appearance for Drums/Synth keeps the same component anatomy with their own product accents (no product token values changed).

Headless Chromium captures omit OS-level caret/scrollbar chrome; harness captures are offscreen software renders (no GPU), which is the documented capture method for the native side; no window-server capture was available in the sandbox.
